sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Hideout Management is a Practical skill in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Efficient hideout management allows you to use less fuel and filters in production, and increases bonuses from different Hideout zones.

sections.heading: Hideout
sections.text: - Level 5 of this skill is needed for the Library

sections.heading: Effects
sections.text:
- Increases all percentage bonuses from Hideout zones (1% per level → +50% at Elite Level)
- Reduces fuel, air and water filters consumption rate (0.5% per level → -25% at Elite Level)
- Elite level: +2 slots for fuel canisters
- Elite level: +2 slots for water filters
- Elite level: +2 slots for air filters
- Elite level: +2 to the storage limit of coins in a bitcoin farm

sections.heading: How to raise
sections.text:
- Crafting items in the Hideout
  - 0.8 upon finishing a craft
  - The point gain is not affected by the Library even though it's a Practical skill
- Using Scav Case in the Hideout
- Spending resources in the Hideout
- Upgrading modules of the Hideout
  - 12 points per upgrade
- Completing the quest The Choice
- Completing the quest Never Too Late To Learn
- Completing the quest Profit Retention
- Completing the quest A Life Lesson
- Completing the quest Get a Foothold
